# تَصَهْيَنْتَ (taṣahyanta) /ta.sˤah.jan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَصَهْيَنَ (taṣahyana)
# تَصَهْيَنْتِ (taṣahyanti) /ta.sˤah.jan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَصَهْيَنَ (taṣahyana)
# تَصَهْيَنَتْ (taṣahyanat) /ta.sˤah.ja.nat
